Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: approximation algorithms | ID: 50221

Result

Let X be a Hardy space with measurable structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Step 1. By compactness of the polynomial spectral family \(Q_{01280011}\), the image is precompact in the algebraic variety topology.

Step 2. By the polynomial spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01280012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the polynomial spectral family.

Step 3. By the projective spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01280013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the projective spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via iterative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
